lines.zh: 呜咽声回荡，幽灵步履飘忽。
幽灵步履轻盈，飘忽不前。
飘过灰烬森林，无声无息。
魂体穿过灰烬，不扬一粒尘。
lines.en: My soul passes the ash without stirring it.

lines.zh: 脚不着地，沿着刷怪笼转。
灰烬落进我空空的胸口。
lines.en: Ash falls through my hollow chest.

lines.zh: 灰烬森林的刷怪笼，困住我很久了。
lines.en: The spawner in the ash forest has held me long.

lines.zh: 铁链的响动还在我耳边。
lines.en: The rattle of chains still rings in my ears.
My soul has been caged too long.
The bones in this cage still scream.

lines.zh: 你手中的光让我的灵魂颤抖！
lines.en: The light in your hand shakes my soul!

lines.zh: 被遗忘的幽灵，为何现身于此？
lines.en: A forgotten ghost, why show yourself here?
Come near me, your luck is done!

lines.zh: 饥饿的灵魂渴望着光芒。
lines.en: A hungry soul craves the light.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你将后悔！
lines.en: Stay back or you’ll regret it!
Light is a curse, not a shield.

lines.zh: 在这片灰烬之中，只有绝望。
死亡的呼唤，无人能逃离。
lines.en: The call of death, none escape.

lines.zh: 我被束缚于此，寻求解脱。

lines.en: You're too warm, keep your distance.

lines.zh: 这间屋子，我死了也占着。
lines.en: This room is mine, even in death.

lines.zh: 你闯入了不该出现的地方。
lines.en: You entered a place you should not.

lines.zh: 别来烦我，我已经够凄凉。
lines.en: Leave me alone, I am already wretched.

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你会后悔。
lines.en: Stay away or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 不要打扰我，我已经够孤单。
lines.en: Do not bother me, I am already alone.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我更显凄凉。
lines.en: Your presence makes me more wretched.

lines.zh: 穿过去吧，我早已不是活物。
lines.en: Pass through; I am no living thing.

lines.zh: 寻找一个可以并肩的灵魂。
lines.en: Find a soul to walk with.

lines.zh: 我的爱侣，我唯一的愿望。

lines.en: I desire to share with you.

lines.zh: 寻找一个可以并肩的灵魂伴侣。
lines.en: Find a soulmate to walk with.

lines.zh: 愿我们的灵魂永不分离。
被遗忘的怨灵，徘徊于此。
幽魂无处安身，四处飘荡。
刷怪笼一响，我就锁住你。
lines.en: The spawner clicks, and I have you.

lines.zh: 灰烬森林的笼子关着我。
灰烬森林的刷怪笼，放我出来了。
lines.en: The spawner in the ash forest let me out.
I will devour you with vengeance.
Your death will atone for me.
The cage woke, and so did I.

lines.zh: 你踏进了我被困的地方。
lines.en: You entered the place I am bound to.
I know that gold trinket you wear.
The purification still lacks one essence.

lines.zh: 靠近笼子的人，都要留下。
lines.en: All who near the cage must stay.

lines.zh: 现在，我将吸取你的灵魂。
lines.en: Now, I will absorb your soul.
I will turn you to ash.
You will live forever in flames.
Exchange your life for my soul.

lines.zh: 你身上的生气，我要吸走。
lines.en: I'll drain the life off you.
Your soul will stay with me.

lines.zh: 我数过你还有几次呼吸。
lines.en: I have counted your remaining breaths.
The ash will remember your name.

lines.zh: 我的怨念缠在你的脚上。
lines.en: My grudge coils around your feet.
The cage's chains pull at you too.
Don't run; souls don't get far.

lines.zh: 我听见你心跳乱了一拍。

lines.en: Every light here has gone out.
Closing in like a ghost,无形之手!

lines.zh: 灵魂的低语，致命的攻击！
lines.en: A whisper of a soul, a致命的攻击!

lines.zh: 你感受到了幽灵的触碰？
lines.en: Feel the touch of the ghost?
The power of the soul,致命一击!

lines.zh: 我的指骨扣进你的肩膀。
lines.en: My finger bones dig into your shoulder.
The fury of the怨灵,致命一击!

lines.zh: 冰冷的手穿过你的胸口！
lines.en: A cold hand passes through your chest!

lines.zh: 你的体温被我带走一点。
lines.en: I take a little of your warmth.
My wail crawls into your ears!
You stepped into the place I died.
The spawner flares, and here I am.
I rise out of the ash heap.
Whispers of a soul, ghost appears!

lines.zh: 笼中浮现一张猪灵的脸。
lines.en: A piglin face surfaces in the cage.
Chains rattle deep in the structure.

lines.zh: 火把我剩下的一点形烧散了。
lines.en: Fire scatters what little shape I have left.

lines.zh: 灰烬森林的笼子把我关到现在。
lines.en: The cage in the ash forest still holds me.
blown to pieces by the explosion
The arrow passes through; my soul closes again.

lines.zh: 闪电把我剩下的怨气劈亮。
lines.en: Lightning lights up what spite I have left.

lines.zh: 我被锁在灰烬的刷怪笼里。
lines.en: I'm chained to a spawner in the ash.
